rationale: 357's population: 22 live page_components rows each storing a whole working interactive tool under the SHARED hero component's identity — regeneration is the disaster arm (a 2KB hero band minted over a 16KB tool). The previously designed repair (578, retype onto the shared adopted-fragment) left rebuild-safety resting on the armed Layer 2 identity-carry, which is exactly what its own precondition 4 required proving and which this lane showed can only ever be tested VACUOUSLY in place (HANDOFF_2026-08-26b Findings 1-2: the canary chain skips end to end and the conservation loop never runs). Post-701 a rebuild renders the adopted template - byte-identical - so the regeneration hazard is closed BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by an untested guard; this is the estate's own fix-ranking rule (make the bad state unrepresentable). Pre-design measurements, all 2026-09-02: the drift reconciler compares pages.built_from_plan_version (a site_plans.id) to the current plan id, and 701 creates no plan row and never touches built_from_plan_version - no drift storm; all 22 stored bodies carry ZERO '{{' (adoption is lossless population-wide, guarded again at apply); all 22 bodies PASS toolTemplateValid through the real production function (in-package probe, must-fail AND must-pass controls both proven, probe deleted); exactly ONE library function collision (tool-equity-release, active manual row a5236dec) - that one adopted component is born a FORK per RFC_036 section 9.3 (verified verbatim: forked_from = the claiming row's id), the other 21 insert with forked_from NULL; section resolution at rebuild tries the STORED component_id first, so repointed rows resolve directly. Selection is by PINNED CENSUS (22 pc_ids + md5s), never by predicate - the licensing measurements were taken against these exact bodies, so the population predicate is re-run at apply time as an exact-set GUARD that aborts on growth (a growth also means the phase 2 birth-fix regressed) or any per-row drift. Scoped apply: -v scope=pilot (DEFAULT, mortgagecalculator/tool-simple alone) then scope=remainder (refuses unless the pilot is verified repaired), per the staged plan; by hand, never the runner (_HOLD). Rollback restores all three legs from a backup table holding full pre-state jsonb, is all-or-nothing with per-row state classification, and carries the inverted deployed_at warning (a rebuild that already deployed from the new identity makes blind rollback WORSE - it re-arms 357's disaster arm). (4) NAME UNIQUENESS is enforced, not asserted: content_components_name_key UNIQUE CONSTRAINT btree(name), read from \d content_components 2026-09-02. (6) DOC_PLANS TOOL FENCES measured: 10 rows over 8 stripped-form subject_keys exist (all mortgagecalculator); NONE mentions component/slot/hero in its body; fences key on the tool NAME, unchanged by 701 - Tier 2 unaffected, measured. (7) DISCOVERY CHECKS are placement-scoped: check_missing_tools counts via JOIN through page_components ON THE SITE (:85-92), tool_eligibility likewise - a library row alone counts for nobody.
